opening.argument: The video puts a free $500 Nike gift card offer directly before viewers and tells them how to pursue it. Its description says viewers can “stand a chance to get free $500 Nike gift card!” alongside an external shortened link, while the video instructs them to “Click Link on Description.” Nike-branded gift-card imagery and form-like screens reinforce the offer. This is presented as an opportunity to obtain the reward, not as reporting on or criticism of someone else’s promotion.
